name: Airzolver Garland
original_name: エアゾルバ・ガーランド
source:
A Quad Ride instructor and Public Morals advisor. He loves the gym.
He can be pretty strict and has a bad mouth.
Even though he's the 'public morals' advisor, that no shirt plus necktie combo is probably against the uniform rules.
